review_candidates.title: Packet Switching Core Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Summary We are seeking a PS (Packet Switched) Core Network Engineer to operate, maintain, and optimize PS core networks across 2G, 3G, 4G, and 5G environments. The role covers daily operations, advanced troubleshooting, solution implementation, and network evolution activities, with responsibilities aligned to the engineers experience level. Experience Levels Engineer: 3 Years Senior Engineer: 5–8 Years Responsibilities & Technical Requirements: Advanced Troubleshooting & Maintenance Strong
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Experience Levels Engineer: 3 Years Senior Engineer: 5–8 Years Responsibilities & Technical Requirements: Advanced Troubleshooting & Maintenance Strong capability in comprehensive troubleshooting and routine PS core maintenance Solid understanding of IPv4 networking and subnetting Expertise in trace capture and analysis tools: PCAP, Traceview Proficient with FMA for traffic statistics, alarms, operation logs, and CHR analysis Mobility, Interfaces & Services Strong command of mobility and session management: Attach, TAU, Handover, PDP setup, session setup Registration, inter-RAT interworking User authentication, NE selection, QoS principles Knowledge of interface signaling tracing and analysis: Ga, Gn, Iu, Gr, Gb, S1-MME, S1-U, S5, S8, SGi, Gx, Gy PS Core Implementation Hands-on experience with 2G / 3G / 4G PS service implementations: SGSN/MME pooling Address pool allocation CSFB Experien
